defects.what: Share is the only filled control and the loudest thing, though the main task is reading the trend
Colours have no stable meaning: plan colours reuse the MRR/accent blue, each sparkline an arbitrary hue
Cohort heatmap labels fail contrast in light and especially dark mode
Cohort table shows an empty current-month row that reads as broken
On phone the toolbar wraps into uneven rows and KPI trend context is dropped
Quick ranges wrap unevenly and are out of order; popover covers the KPIs it changes
Quick ranges apply instantly but custom range needs Apply; reversed range swapped silently
Immediate downloads and a persistent schedule setup in one flat list; focus ring reads as selection
defects.note: The focus-ring part may come from the harness: surfaces are opened with a scripted click, and Chrome shows focus rings when there was no real pointer input.

defects.what: Close button 34px, under the 44px touch minimum; no outside-tap exit on phone
Drawer padded with made-up rows and a status that never varies; no action
'Remove' is an option inside the role select and applies immediately with no confirmation or undo
Link field opens scrolled to the end; small grey access text; unlabeled toggles
Tooltip repeats legend figures; hover earns little
Delta badges contradict the chart, and arrow direction and colour are read two ways

reviewer: Claude Sonnet, blind review of screenshots and source (never saw the rule list)

removed.what: Tooltip covers the slice it describes
removed.why: Artifact of the harness: the surface was opened with a scripted click from a hidden section or at a fixed point, so its position is not what a person would see.
